fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the purse of the complainant with cash and cards was allegedly lifted while queueing at Kurinji Puram Railway Station Road. The matter was brought to Coimbatore Town PS on 2025-05-17, while the incident was placed on 2025-05-15 at approximately 15:55. The complainant, Tamilselvi Devi, provided the contact number 9000000452. Gunasekar Anand (mobile 9000000050) was named as a possible person of interest. A bus with registration number TN-45-ZZ-1062 was mentioned in connection with the incident. A second person, Senthil Sekar (9000000174), was also mentioned as possibly present. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Reported theft occurred while the victim was boarding a bus. The incident reportedly took place on a bus.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, suspect, afternoon, mobile number, railway station road, CCTV, bus
